classification_rationale: Coarse trigger (division operations in balance/value-computation contexts) plausible, similar in character to req-2-overflow-underflow's coarse trigger from Track A -- over-inclusive by itself. Three sub-obligations (document error range; don't lose/create value; no exploitable round-trip) all require genuine mathematical/financial reasoning about a SPECIFIC formula's behavior -- the semantic-reviewer's job here is substantial, closer in weight to req-2-overflow-underflow's than to req-2-verify-exact-balance-check's narrow case.
